$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md).

tasks.name: google-trends-interest-over-time
tasks.title: Google Trends interest over time for your keywords
tasks.description: Get each keyword's Google search interest over the last 12 months on Google's 0 to 100 scale, with its top regions and related queries, one timeline point per week. Replace bitcoin and chatgpt with your keywords, or type your own date range.
tasks.seoTitle: Google Trends API - Interest Over Time by Keyword
tasks.seoDescription: Google search interest over time for each keyword, 0 to 100, with top regions and related queries. 12 months by default, any date range. pytrends alternative.

tasks.name: google-trends-trending-now
tasks.title: Google Trends Trending Now: today's top searches in a country
tasks.description: Every search trending on Google in the United States over the last 24 hours, the Trending Now list, with search volume, when it started, related queries and news links. Pick another country or a 4-hour to 7-day window.
tasks.seoTitle: Google Trends Trending Now - Top Searches Today
tasks.seoDescription: Every search trending on Google in a country in the last 24 hours, with volume, start time, related queries and news links. Any country, 4 hours to 7 days.

tasks.name: google-trends-compare-keywords
tasks.title: Compare keywords on Google Trends on one shared scale
tasks.description: Compare 2 to 5 keywords side by side on one shared 0 to 100 scale, as on trends.google.com, to see which one people search for more and how that changed over the last 12 months. Swap in your own brands or products.
tasks.seoTitle: Compare Keywords on Google Trends - Side by Side
tasks.seoDescription: Compare 2 to 5 keywords on one shared Google Trends scale over time, like trends.google.com side by side. See which brand or product people search more.
